verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395 is a laptop/desktop processor (APU), not a service with a user interface, so API-versus-UI feature parity is a category error for this kind of product. The surrounding Ryzen AI software stack does expose Python/C++ APIs, a server interface and the xrt-smi CLI. However, there is no product UI whose capabilities those APIs could mirror, so the parity axis does not apply.
